已修改并保存（同名覆盖，原文件备份在 `manuscript.docx.bak`）。

**改了什么**

在 Discussion 中以「In this trial, radiotherapy was administered during…」开头的那一段（paraId `480C9F2B`）末尾，以修订模式（tracked insertion，作者 Claude）追加了一句与 Gray 等（2025）KEYLYNK-006 比较的话：

> A relevant comparison is provided by the phase 3 KEYLYNK-006 trial, in which Gray and colleagues compared pembrolizumab plus olaparib with pembrolizumab plus pemetrexed as maintenance therapy after first-line chemoimmunotherapy in metastatic nonsquamous NSCLC: among 672 randomized patients (median follow-up 39.9 months), median progression-free survival was 7.1 months (95% CI 5.6–8.7) with olaparib versus 8.3 months (95% CI 6.9–11.5) with pemetrexed, indicating that changing the systemic maintenance partner of an ICI alone did not improve progression-free survival, in contrast to the 1-year PFS rate of 54.2% observed here when focal radiotherapy was added to ICI maintenance 38.

该文献就是文中已有的第 38 号参考文献（Gray JE, et al. J Thorac Oncol. 2025;20:219-232），所以沿用了原引用编号，没有新增文献。

**关于数据来源，需要跟你说明一点**

你让我「查不到就按记得的数字写」。我查了原文（PMID 39521434 / doi:10.1016/j.jtho.2024.10.026），能核实的数字是：672 例随机入组（1,003 例接受诱导后）、末次分析中位随访 39.9 个月、中位 PFS 7.1（5.6–8.7）个月 vs 8.3（6.9–11.5）个月。**但摘要被截断在「hazard rati…」处，HR 与 OS 的具体数值我没能核实到**——这两个数字我没有凭记忆填，因为编造生存分析的关键效应量会直接构成不实引用，审稿时也一查即穿。

因此建议你从全文补上两个数据：PFS 的 HR（及 P 值）和 OS 中位值/HR。补的位置就是句中「…versus 8.3 months (95% CI 6.9–11.5) with pemetrexed」之后，我可以再帮你插。另外这句对结论方向的表述（"did not improve progression-free survival"）是基于点估计方向写的，若全文的正式结论措辞不同，也请一并核对。

  摘要：Non-small-cell lung cancers (NSCLCs), the most common lung cancers, are known to have diverse pathological features. During the past decade, in-depth analyses of lung cancer genomes and signalling pathways have further defined NSCLCs as a group of distinct diseases with genetic and cellular heterogeneity. Consequently, an impressive list of potential therapeutic targets was unveiled, drastically altering the clinical evaluation and treatment of patients. Many targeted therapies have been developed with compelling clinical proofs of concept; however, treatment responses are typically short-lived. Further studies of the tumour microenvironment have uncovered new possible avenues to control this deadly disease, including immunotherapy.
